title: Launch a private copy of the codex binary, so the file probed is the file run
evidence: US-40 AC19 binds a review to one binary by device, inode, size, mtime and sha256, checked again just before launch, with one fresh probe on a change (owner ruling 2026-11-27: keep this). The launch still runs the binary by path, so a sub-millisecond window remains between that check and the spawn. Option: copy the binary once into the run's private 0700 work folder, then probe and launch that copy. Open question: does the CLI bundled in the ChatGPT app run when copied out of its app bundle? A no-model check (--version and features list on a copy) would answer it. tools/codex-review-bin.mjs recheckCodex
